label: Recherche+
description: Dasselbe Verfahren wie Recherche, aber auf Sonnet — hinterlässt einen prüfbaren Nachweis (~4 Quellenprüfungen je Lauf statt 0,25). Kostet ~33 ct je Lauf, und die Anfragen verlassen das Haus.
opening: Ich habe eine Frage zu recherchieren.
_why_this_exists: The question this settles was open for a day: local model or cloud model
for research. It was posed as a choice and it is not one. Since an agent
became a folder, two instances cost no code -- so the fork is offered to
whoever asks the question, at the moment they ask it, when they alone know
whether the subject may leave the house.
Everything except `model`, `timeout` and `limits` is identical to
`recherche` BY CONSTRUCTION, not by care: SOUL.md is a symlink to the same
file, and the skill is the same folder. That is what makes a comparison
between the two measure the MODEL. Two copies of a prose file drift within
a week, and the drift is invisible in exactly the measurement it ruins.
Nach dem Gleichziehen der Nutzlasten am 2026-09-02 ist es INHALTLICH nicht
mehr besser: 94 % gegen 94 % auf denselben sechs Fragen. Der Punktabstand
davor war die Konfiguration, nicht das Modell.
Was bleibt, ist der Nachweis -- 4,2 Quellenpruefungen je Lauf gegen 0,25 --
und die Abwesenheit erfundener Zitate, die lokal in 3 von 14 Laeufen auftraten
(unter inhaltlich RICHTIGEN Antworten, was sie schwer erkennbar macht).
Deshalb bleibt der Agent: fuer Fragen, nach deren Antwort gehandelt wird, und
als zweite Meinung, wenn eine lokale Antwort bezweifelt wird. Der Blender-
Fehler wurde genau so gefunden -- zwei Laeufe widersprachen sich.
_why_model: Cloud, permissible only because this agent reads and does not steer: no
flow tools, so it cannot direct the factory (ADR-004, and the standing rule
that the control plane stays local). The tool list is what makes the model
line a data field rather than a forbidden one.
Queries and page contents leave the house. Fine for a coffee machine or a
container image, not for a client. That judgement belongs to whoever asks,
which is why this is a separate agent to pick rather than a setting to
_why_limits: Sized for a 1M window. Measured 2026-09-01: with the payloads cut for a
small window, a Sonnet turn took 28 tool calls and eight minutes and never
finished, because five reads were forced where one would have done. A
narrow payload does not save time, it multiplies round trips.
page_chars 4000 rather than 10000 after measuring where a five-minute turn
goes: reading eight pages costs 1.6 s, eight searches cost 20 s, and the
model costs the rest. Page text is resent with every later call of the same
turn -- paid once in latency and many times in tokens. The notes are what
_why_timeout: 25 minutes. Measured: this model made 28 calls and read 15 pages in one
turn -- a 1M window removes every reason to hold back -- and ran into a
